items.fight_news: The biggest star in UFC history returns as Conor McGregor faces Max Holloway in a highly anticipated welterweight rematch, 13 years after their first meeting.
The massive main event narrative centers on whether McGregor's legendary one-punch knockout power can finally crack Holloway's incredible durability and relentless pace.

bouts.title: Benoît Saint Denis vs. Paddy Pimblett

items.fight_news: A monumental European showdown takes place in the co-main event as gritty French powerhouse Benoît Saint Denis clashes with Liverpool's superstar Paddy Pimblett.
Fans expect pure chaos, with Saint Denis looking to firmly establish his contender status against the fan-favorite Pimblett's unpredictable style.
In a high-stakes bantamweight clash, Cory Sandhagen looks to bounce back into immediate title contention against the red-hot Mario Bautista.
Bautista enters the Octagon having won nine of his last ten fights, setting up a beautiful stylistic clash of striking versus grinding pressure.
A classic veteran versus prospect matchup is set as former title challenger Brandon Royval tests the undefeated British sensation Lone'er Kavanagh.
The flyweight bout promises high-speed action, contrasting Royval's wild scrambles against Kavanagh's pristine kickboxing.
Opening the main card, the battle-tested King Green looks to weather the terrifying early storm of Terrance McKinney.
With McKinney boasting 17 first-round finishes, the tension in the arena will be palpable from the very first second of the fight.
Former middleweight champion Robert Whittaker takes a massive risk by testing the waters at light heavyweight against the dangerous Russian veteran Nikita Krylov.
Whittaker's speed and technique will be heavily tested by Krylov's significant size and finishing instincts.
Olympic gold medalist Gable Steveson continues his highly anticipated MMA run in the heavyweight division.
Elisha Ellison steps up to face the terrifying grappling pedigree of the decorated prospect in what is sure to be a spectacle.
A bantamweight banger guaranteed to deliver, as former champion Cody Garbrandt's lightning-fast hands meet the crisp boxing of Adrian Yanez.
Both men are known for their highlight-reel knockouts, making a judges' decision highly unlikely.

bouts.title: Luke Riley vs. Kai Kamaka III

items.fight_news: Undefeated prospect Luke Riley takes a massive leap in competition against the incredibly durable and experienced Kai Kamaka III.
This preliminary bout serves as a crucial litmus test for Riley's potential in the featherweight division.
A pivotal women's flyweight bout sees Tracy Cortez looking to impose her grappling will against the highly touted Chinese striking specialist Wang Cong.
Middleweight action heats up as the undefeated Damian Pinas looks to solve the high-level striking puzzle presented by Brazilian kickboxer Cesar Almeida.
The undefeated Farid Basharat aims to continue his flawless rise through the bantamweight ranks against the hungry and motivated John Garza.
A classic striker clash in the middleweight division features Ryan Gandra attempting to chop down the towering Zachary Reese in an intriguing stylistic matchup.
Setting the tone for the night, Alessandro Costa looks to unleash his heavy hands against the gritty, wrestling-heavy style of veteran Cody Durden to open the early prelims.
